::: {#sol-racket-step}

`(assoc 'q1 pairs-table)` is the row `'(q1 (#\a q2) (#\b q0))`,
and its rest is `'((#\a q2) (#\b q0))`.
`(assoc #\b ...)` finds `'(#\b q0)` in that list, and its second element is `'q0`.
So `(step pairs-table 'q1 #\b)` returns `'q0`, which is $\delta(q_1, \mathtt{b})$ (@exm-pairs-dfa).

:::
